teaser: What do you do with a plan too large to finish in one sitting? Life path 22 hands you that question from the start, and you are also an ISFJ, built to notice the small thing that keeps a household running before anyone asks. The 22 pushes toward structures that outlast a single life; the ISFJ keeps faith with the people already in the room. That crossing asks for ambition carried quietly, built one dependable act at a time, with no announcement owed to anyone until it is finished.
